Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Must I judge Grandma for calling on the Prophet?

No one is given a label here. What the Quran says of judgment, the heart, mercy, and your grandmother's love.

Part 1 of 5

﴿وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."[1410]

Translator's notes

[1410] In remembrance and repentance.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:10

Translation

For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃

Isaiah · 33:22

World English Bible

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَبَيَّنُوا۟ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَنْ أَلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا تَبْتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ كَثِيرَةٌ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كُنتُم مِّن قَبْلُ فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, when you go forth [to fight] in the cause of Allāh, investigate; and do not say to one who gives you [a greeting of] peace, "You are not a believer,"[211] aspiring for the goods of worldly life; for with Allāh are many acquisitions. You [yourselves] were like that before; then Allāh conferred His favor [i.e., guidance] upon you, so investigate. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

Translator's notes

[211] Do not assume that he pretends Islām merely in order to save himself, for he may be sincere in faith.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:94

You ask because you love her, and perhaps because someone said a hard word about her. So begin with what this page will not do: it puts that word on no one, and no one was given that task. The verse says that whatever people differ over, its judgment rests with God. You can weigh an idea. What is inside a person when she calls out in her need is known to the One who hears her.

A question for you

Who can see what is in her heart when she calls?

If you sayGod alone.
ThenThen the verdict you were afraid of is not yours to give, and it belongs to no one else on earth.
If you sayI can. I have known her all my life.
ThenYou know her love better than anyone. The verse still keeps one room closed, and that may be a relief. What is asked of you is to love her.
If you saySomeone told me what she is.
ThenThen ask what that person was given. The verse leaves judgment with God and grants no one that seat.

Part 2 of 5

﴿ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Call them[1181] by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

Translator's notes

[1181] Those children under your care.

Quran · Al-Ahzab 33:5

Translation

Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors. Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

Original · Hebrew

שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי־יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃ גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים ׀ חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃

the Psalms · 19:12-13

World English Bible

This verse is about how to name adopted children, so read it in its place. It closes with a sentence wider than its subject: no blame for what you did in error, only for what hearts set out to do. Many readers have applied this beyond adoption, and the verse does not say how far it reaches. Whatever one holds about her words, the question is what her heart intends, and she may well tell you: I know he is God's servant.

A question for you

When she calls out, what do you think she is reaching for?

If you sayComfort, from someone she loves.
ThenThen what you have seen in her is love under pressure. That is real, and nothing here takes it from her.
If you sayShe believes he hears and will ask God for her.
ThenThen she knows where the answer comes from. Whether he hears, and whether to ask in this way, is a real dispute among scholars, and it has its own question.
If you sayHelp from him directly.
ThenAsk her gently, if you can, who she thinks gave him that. Her answer may surprise you.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenThat is the truest thing one person can say about another's heart, and it is a good place to begin.

Part 3 of 5

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱفْتَرَىٰٓ إِثْمًا عَظِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allāh has certainly fabricated a tremendous sin.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:48

Translation

“Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

Original · Hebrew

וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וֵאלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃

Hosea · 13:4

World English Bible

People often reach for this verse, so read all of it. It names the gravest thing, giving God a partner, and then opens forgiveness for everything below it, to whom He wills. In both halves the one acting is God. The verse gives no reader a post from which to apply it to a named person. Whether a given call falls under it is what scholars have disputed for centuries, with love on every side. If she says she worships God alone, keep her word. Leave the rest with Him.

A question for you

Which half of this verse have you heard quoted more?

If you sayThe first half.
ThenThen you have heard its weight, and the second half is yours too. Read it once more, slowly, with her name in mind.
If you sayThe second half.
ThenThen you heard it from people of hope. The first half keeps the matter serious, and the one acting in both halves is still God.
If you sayI have heard it used against people.
ThenThe verse speaks of what God forgives. It says nothing about who may carry it against whom. You are free to read it as it stands.

Part 4 of 5

﴿لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ١٢٨ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ١٢٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you [i.e., your guidance] and to the believers is kind and merciful. But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne."

Quran · At-Tawbah 9:128-129

Her love is real, and it has a real object. The Quran describes him: your hardship weighs on him, he is eager for your good, and toward believers he is gentle and merciful. No wonder she turns to him. Now read the next verse. The one she loves is told what to say when people turn away from him: God is enough for me, on Him I rely. Her love, if it follows him, leads to the words he was given to say.

A question for you

If she could ask him what to do with her pain, what do you think he would tell her?

Part 5 of 5

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

Quran · Al-Hashr 59:10

Translation

My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake. Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

Original · Hebrew

הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשֲׁמָע֒ פְּקַ֣ח עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֨ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֨עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקֲשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעֲנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃

Daniel · 9:18-19

World English Bible

There is one thing left that you can do. The Quran gives a prayer for those who came after, about those who went before them in faith: forgive us and them, and leave no bitterness in our hearts toward any believer. This is a prayer you can say for her, with your own mouth, to God, in whatever words you have. It also asks something of you: a heart with no hardness toward her, or toward whoever spoke hard words about her.

A question for you

What would you most want to ask God for her?

The same in the other books

Translation

Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

Original · Ancient Greek

Τὸ δὲ τέλος πάντες ὁμόφρονες, συμπαθεῖς, φιλάδελφοι, εὔσπλαγχνοι, ταπεινόφρονες,

1 Peter · 3:8

World English Bible

Your reflection

What do you want your grandmother to know about how you see her?
